scope: Hash-pinned A1 production Gaussian on the fixed L=16 torus, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the declared common real-even scalar spectral scope. The exact frozen-shell determinant trace is Gamma_j and the coefficient commutator uses Gamma_le_j. A sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration is realised with independent innovations and a uniform terminal L4 projection bound. The theorem proves an exact multiscale action-bookkeeping obstruction and a conditional composition formula; it does not prove either a production-valid reconstruction of the actual A7 action or the all-field stabilised log-Laplace antecedent.

frozen_shell_convention.warning: Replacing Gamma_j by Gamma_le_j in Q_fr changes the A9 determinant variable and is forbidden.

theorem.coefficient_structure: B(X)=sum_A [p_A v_A] Q_II [p_A v_A]^T is PSD; ||B(X)||_F<=beta_B|X|^2 and ||DB(X)[h]||_F<=beta_1|X||h|.
theorem.raw_identity: For q_x=q_(B(x))(Dz) and q_z=q_(B(z))(Dz), theta Q_fr,raw+C_raw=q_z-(1-theta)q_x.
theorem.strict_dyadic_sharpness: On the physical scalar ray, partial sums F_m and F_(2m) of the inner Blaschke factor form legitimate hard dyadic splits and satisfy q_current/q_frozen->0. Hence theta=1 is the sharp cost-free raw retained fraction even under strict shell geometry.
theorem.trace_defect: For x=0 and z=A exp(i k.x)e_1 in one new shell, Q_fr=0 and J_A=K_A=0, but C_j=-t_(Gamma_le_j)(B(z))<0.
theorem.trace_defect_mitigation: The identified plane-wave trace loss is O(K A^2), while its Cameron-Martin shift entropy is O(K^4 A^2); their ratio is O(K^-3). This mitigates that family only and is not the all-field estimate.
theorem.triad_budget: For the registered scalar triad, alpha_c*epsilon_6 >= [(c_C-theta*c_F)_+]^2/(4*c_H*c_6); theta=3/16 only neutralises epsilon=0.3 and is not global.
theorem.multiscale_action_identity: For V_j=q_(B(phi_j))(D phi_j)-t_(Gamma_le_j)(B(phi_j)), Q_j^fr+C_j=V_j-V_(j-1)+q_(B(phi_(j-1)))(D phi_(j-1)); hence, with V_0=0, sum_j(Q_j^fr+C_j)=V_J+sum_j q_(B(phi_(j-1)))(D phi_(j-1)). The extra past-energy sum is nonnegative on the shell action, so recovering the actual A7 action requires subtracting it and is not supplied by positivity.
theorem.dyadic_filtration_realisation: For N_j=2^j and the sharp rectangular-cube multiplier P_<=j=1_(max_a |n_a|<=N_j), disjoint Fourier blocks give independent Gaussian innovations. The one-dimensional symmetric partial sum is the difference of two modulated Riesz projections, so the M. Riesz theorem and tensorisation give ||P_<=j||_(L4(T3)->L4)<=C_4^3 uniformly. This closes A10-CLASSII-DYADIC-FILTRATION-REALISATION for this route.
theorem.conditional_composition: For the realised sharp-cube filtration, if a separate production-valid action decomposition or domination removes the exact past-energy mismatch and the open relative form bound holds, then the retained A9 fraction plus production quartic-sextic potential yields the explicit uniform p-th Nelson ceiling stated in the proof note. The two antecedents remain open.
